messages.subject: Re: reproduce growth model (FIML estimation) with covariance matrices
parts: the latent means are estimated to be zero in fit2.  I guess I am missing something
The sample.means= argument (see ?lavaan help page)

Also, I do not get the robust statistics (apparently "mlr" is not allowed).  

Is there a way to reproduce the model perfectly in lavaan without raw data (i.e., no discrepancies in the output)?

No, the MLR adjustment is estimated from the observed data's kurtosis, about which the means and covariances have no information.  Even without robust SEs, using summary statistics will only allow you to reproduce FIML's point estimates correctly, because N will not be correct for most parameters due to incomplete data.

These objects are irrelevant for MLR; they are used for (D)WLS estimation.
